title: Parsimonious Argument Annotations for Hate Speech Counter-narratives

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating hate speech tweets targeting immigrants (from the HatEval corpus) with argumentative structures (e.g., premises, conclusions, targeted collectives, assigned properties, and pivots) and evaluating the performance of machine learning models (RoBERTa, BiLSTM-CNN-CRF, Logistic Regression) in automatically extracting these components to aid in counter-narrative generation.
